English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false Fake Message Circulating About Free Offers from DIALOG False No official announcement has been issued by DIALOG regarding the provision of any free offers. by Anonymous | June 3, 2025 FactSeeker has observed a WhatsApp message being shared with the headline: “Free Data for Old DIALOG SIM Users!” The message reads as follows: “CONGRATULATIONS TO ALL DIALOG OLD CUSTOMERS DIALOG is Offering Free Data to all OLD SIM CARD ✅ 6 Month Old Sim – 5GB ✅ 1 Year and above – 10GB ✅ 5 Years and above – 50GB ✅ 10 Years plus – 100GB Hurry Now and check if your DIALOG SIM CARD is eligible for this offer CHECK HERE👇 https://sureconnect.xyz/freedataoffer As this message has been rapidly circulating among WhatsApp users, FactSeeker investigated the matter following a request it received. Upon checking the official website and social media pages of DIALOG, FactSeeker found no official announcements confirming the existence of such offers. Furthermore, when FactSeeker inquired directly with DIALOG, the company clarified that it is not providing any such free data offers as mentioned in the message. They also stated that if such offers are ever introduced, customers would be informed directly via official communication to their mobile phones. Therefore, FactSeeker confirms that the WhatsApp message claiming “Free Data for Old DIALOG SIM Users!” is false. Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase?
